articles.title: Yellow Card raises $40 million to link banks to stablecoin processing
articles.snippet: The funds bring Yellow Card’s total financing to more than $120 million since being founded 10 years ago.

articles.title: Circle shares fall 3% despite earnings beat as stablecoin issuer misses on revenue
articles.snippet: Shares initially jumped 10% but later fell 3% in pre-market trading as the stablecoin issuer revealed institutional adoption for its layer 1 blockchain Arc but missed on revenue.

articles.title: Open USD rattled Circle's stock, but its key backers still support USDC
articles.snippet: Executives at Coinbase, Visa and Mastercard said they plan to support multiple stablecoins, suggesting Open USD is another payments rail rather than a direct replacement for USDC.

articles.title: Samsung is poised to become a dominant stablecoin distributor, analysts say
articles.snippet: Samsung seeks to turn 800 million Galaxy phones into wallets for digital assets and blockchain payments, backed by a deeper play in crypto infrastructure.

articles.title: Western Union brings stablecoin remittances to Visa network with Stablecard
articles.snippet: The remittance giant is rolling out Stablecard across 37 markets, targeting cross-border payments and consumers seeking US dollar-denominated savings in volatile economies.
